This is the notes/mwccarm-codegen.md 6t/6u single-condition-guard predication floor (documented 2026-07-16, names this function). mwccarm cond-opt refuses to predicate a CFG block with >=2 predecessors; a single-condition trailing guard has one predecessor, so cond-opt always collapses 'beq done; <1-instr mov>; done:' to movne regardless of source phrasing. Precedent func_0205c048 matches only because its logic has a genuine second condition. Independently re-tested rather than taken on faith: a guard-clause-with-goto variant compiles to 0x74 (4 bytes short) on BOTH compilers, reproducing the collapse. Manufacturing a second predecessor costs bytes the ROM does not spend (+8 double-goto, +4 redundant inner if, +8 loop; measured in 6u). All pragmas inert; asm barriers lower to IR before cond-opt. src/func_02068398.c stays an asm hatch.

It does isolate the rule: r3 goes to the web the four single stores read as a shifter operand, which in the ROM is the same web as the truncation because the lsl happens in place inside it.
